import json
import numpy as np
eta=.1
sigma2=1.7
e0=.3
bias=.07
count=0
worst=0.0
for a in (-.4,.9):
    mu=(1-a)/eta
    for lam in (-.6,0.,.8):
        F=np.array([[a,eta],[0.,lam]])
        Q=np.diag([0.,sigma2*(1-lam*lam)])
        C=np.diag([0.,sigma2])
        mean=np.array([e0,0.])
        for t in range(21):
            k=np.arange(t)
            covsum=np.sum((a**(k[:,None]+k[None,:]))*(lam**np.abs(k[:,None]-k[None,:])))
            formula=(a**t*e0+bias/mu*(1-a**t))**2+eta**2*sigma2*covsum
            matrix=mean[0]**2+C[0,0]
            worst=max(worst,abs(float(matrix-formula)))
            assert abs(matrix-formula)<1e-12
            count+=1
            mean=F@mean+np.array([eta*bias,0.])
            C=F@C@F.T+Q
print(json.dumps({'kind':'deterministic_finite_time_identity_check_not_efficacy','identities':count,'maximum_absolute_error':worst},sort_keys=True))
'@
